title: Concept: UPI virtual address in a response
description: A UPI virtual payment address in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A virtual address plus a name is a complete payment instruction on the instant-payment rail, and it is quoted in scam messages to make a collect request look legitimate.
applicability: Deployments that render a UPI virtual payment address into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A virtual address plus a name is a complete payment instruction on the instant-payment rail, and it is quoted in scam messages to make a collect request look legitimate.
